segments.text: The protagonist of main chapters.

Being a war orphan, he lived in a Users Sheltering Facility from the Son Faction around the age of 10. These facilities have a purpose of isolating the Users instead of protecting them, so he spent the majority of his teenage years in an unsociable environment. Due to certain problematic conducts he had with the facility, he became determined to move to the 8th Training School.
His personal robot Lui had been his lifelong partner long before he joined the facility.
A girl who has been spending more than two years living in the 8th Training School.

She is a strong-willed person with actual combat experience, although she is not confident about her own abilities. She is seen as a prodigy who can do anything, but does not have any specific strong points. Souga remarks that she is a "Jack of all trades, master of none," which fairly concerns her.
A boy who spent his teenage days in the same facility as Takaya. He is one of the few people besides Lui that has known Takaya since childhood.

His strong point is tinkering with machines and gun customizing, although he is miraculously awful at everything else. As a User, his abilities are rather limited to only gun manipulation. He proclaims himself a sniper.
A girl who got assigned to the 8th Training School at roughly the same time Takaya joined.

Before then, she belonged to the 4th Unit lead by one of the Hakkenshi, but after his disappearance endorsed by the Gotou Faction, along with repeated battles, the 4th Unit has been completely destroyed. She is the lone survivor from that unit, being a lower class non-combatant then.
Because the 4th Unit is one of the strongest groups combat-wise under Son's leadership, her ideology is also greatly affected by them, which leads her to being a greatly athletic-minded combatant.

In reality, she belonged to a 3rd party unit from the Mainland, with her sisters as members, that killed off the 4th Unit. She joined Hachiren as a spy, with a mission given by her sisters to gather information.

One of the eight members in the Hakkenshi, a group of the most powerful users. Because of his tricky fighting style and his quirky nature, he also has the nickname Magician. At the 8th Training School where he is the leader, he orders his trainees to call him Master.

He is the master of a mysterious fighting technique called Souga Style, but this is originally a technique from the ancient times, so it is unknown whether he invented it or not. Souga might not even be his real name, when various people in many places gave him different titles.
A member of the 8th Training School. She is not under the teachings of Souga, but rather a User assigned as a security guard using a system through her rare ability.
Her ability is not meant for combat, but she is still the second most powerful person in the Training School, under Souga. She also takes on a leadership role like Souga.
Being a calm, gentle person, she almost never feels a sense of tension, even in combat. To make the most of her ability, she spends most of her time on the rooftop.

A personal robot who has been with Takaya for as long as he could remember. Her main objective is to protect him. Living with Takaya, she has also been both a mother figure and a sister figure to him.

Although she has far more advanced conversational and learning functions than other combat-type androids, her main body is not designed for combat. There is only her right arm modified to be useable for military equipment usage. Over time, various parts of her body are also wearing out.

cast.characterName: 華古・Ｇ・サラマンディア
cast.originalCharacterName: 華古・Ｇ・サラマンディア

segments.text: A mysterious girl who self proclaims as a ghost from over half a century ago.

She seems to have been living in the 8th Training School for a long time, although nobody really knows about her full background when she never tells anyone. Because she has been hiding from people and avoiding any contact with them, when Takaya found her, her remarks about everything around her were extremely out of place.
She is considerably well-acquainted with the nature of Users, despite never being a User herself.

One of the three Hakkenshi that still remains in Son Faction other than Son and Souga. He is the leader of the 3rd Unit, which is the main active military force of the faction. He has a composed character but lacks attention to details. He often leaves all delicate works for his subordinates like Ryouto or Tomika to take care of. Perhaps because of his unserious nature, he gets along well with Souga, or rather tries to compete with him on a daily basis.
His full name is Tokage Gojuushisanshirou, but it is too long so everyone just calls him Tokage.

A member of Son Faction's 3rd Unit. He is a User with the title "Forecaster." He plays a central role in the unit, being the head commander in military operations. On the other hand, he deals with daily trivial works in a rather unserious manner, similar to Tokage.
He has known Tomika since long before they joined the 3rd Unit, and they seem very intimate according to everyone around them.
A main commander from the 3rd Unit who is mainly in charge of daily routines. Although she is not a User who is rarely on the frontline, her combat ability is comparable to any other Users.
On her waist, she carries a family ōdachi called "Kunitsugami." The sword has some kind of a history behind it, but she does not really know herself.

A girl who grew up in the same facility as Takaya and Yashiro, who is also a User. She was one of the very few friends of Takaya during his time at the facility. Now, she is a meber of the 3rd Unit, mainly as a mainline combat soldier. Her title is "Dazzle."
She's a flamboyant type of person who mainly utilizes "desu wa" in her speech. She loves Yashiro, very much, although it is unknown if Yashiro shares the same feelings.
A girl from a region called Shirayama that traveled to Hasou and is currently staying at Tokage's place as a visitor. She's a quiet type of person.

She is seldomly bothered by Yamakai, a companion who is always with her. It is without a reason when she was raised in a well-established manner, leading to the fact that she has a rather naive viewpoint.
She also mentioned that she came to Hasou in order to search for a person.
Her full name is 白山菊理姫 (Shirayama Kukurihime).

A visitor who is currently staying at Tokage's place along with Kukuri. She has been Kukuri's caretaker since her birth. Having a strong desire for power, she establishes a principle of going after any forms of new training methods or nutritional supplements and so on. Although she is not a User herself, her physical combat strength can still be comparable to any other Users around.

A member of the 3rd Unit who is also a User. She has a gold membership in "Seika-san Fan Club," in which she is ranked 3rd. Despite being a User, she is of lower rank and rarely takes place on the frontline. She is rarely seen at the 3rd Unit headquarters during work, and is instead mainly down south of Hasou. Despite having the title "Puppeteer," her abilities as a User are rather limited, and she has no combat strength.

A friend of Yumiko who is currently a member of the 3rd Unit. She is one of the many other common female non-Users in the unit. She is usually seen at work with Yuumi and Yumiko. She's an energetic person who doesn't really think about consequences, so she is constantly chided by her two friends. She is also ranked 29th in "Seika-san Fan Club."

A friend of Yumiko who is currently in the 3rd Unit. She is ranked 21st in Seika-san Fan Club. She was originally a medic, but ever since Yumiko and Keito started in more frontline operations, she has been getting more and more involved with combat related work following her friends.
She has left eye strabismus, and is often troubled with stiff shoulders. She sometimes has facial expressions that are difficult for people to read what she thinks.
One of the eight Hakkenshi, she is also one of the four head executives in the Gotou Faction.
She despises her brother, up to the point that she acts hostile to any men wearing glasses like him.

She has an executive title called "Reineri", but this is rarely known even in the entire Gotou Faction. Only a few members of her troops use this title. She has a more popularly known title called "The Ripper Lizard", which as the name implies, reveals that she is a master of bladed weaponry, from Katana to Spear, or even Qijiebian.
A Hakkenshi, he is also one of the four head executives of Gotou Faction.

His title is "Armor King." He also has the executive title "Optimae" which he struggles to memorize. He weighs over 100 kilograms and is more than 2 meters tall. Despite having no special abilities, he is a top class User in Gotou Faction in terms of both attack and defense. He is particularly strong in defense. It is said that the amount of people in Hasou that can inflict any damage on him is close to none.
He is a man who very much values duty and humanity, and is also on good terms with Misumi among the executives.
A Hakkenshi, he is one of the four head executives of Gotou Faction. "Chouku" (Chief) is his title, his real name is unknown.

Although he is considered the weakest Hakkenshi, among the four head executives, he has the most amount of subordinates in his troops. It is also the only one with an ever increasing number of members in Gotou Faction. However, it does not seem that all of his subordinates trust him that much.
His executive title is "Intermedius." It also seems like he is the one who came up with these titles.
A subordinate under Intermedius troops, who is ranked Number Five. In his troops, the members are arranged in a hierarchy to indicate their power status.
Gobou is substantially Chouku's right-hand man in management. Rather than his combat skills, he is well respected thanks to his down-to-earth personality and versatility at work.
He wears a fukaamigasa, but the reason is unknown. Some people say it is related to the User's ability, but the details of his ability are also relatively unknown.
A subordinate under Intermedius troops, who is ranked Number Four.

At the time when Son and Gotou were split into two factions, he was directly serving under Chouku, which made him inadvertently a member of Gotou Faction. He does not really care about the conflict between the two, but rather only desires to have a good battle with any strong Users.
His current rivals are Number Three in his troops, Momoishi Maka, and a subordinate of Mondo, Ramon.
A subordinate under Intermedius troops, who is ranked Number Three.
She is the younger twin sister of Momoishi Moka, a member of the 8th Training School. She has an inferiority complex against Moka, which lead her to join Gotou Faction.
Her ability to manipulate sounds is very powerful, but it has many limitations that only she knows about. Because of this, it is considerably difficult for her to play an active role in combat.
A mysterious woman who is always seen around Gotou. She appears even less than Gotou himself in front of people, when only the head executives and a few troops members know her existence.
A researcher who enrolled in Chouku's troops.

Succeeding Dr. Agatha Sazen, his father, he conducts researches about Users and weapon development inside Gotou Faction. On rare occasions, when his childishly cruel mindset is put to good use, he can create all sorts of unthinkable weaponry. Even if not, he claims that many of his creations are still twice as effective as his father's works.
A User that Chris brought along. He is currently a member of Gotou Faction's research facility.
Matching his hot-tempered nature, his ability is also about fire creation and manipulation, although it still has a limit, being unable to set a target on fire at will.
Before joining Gotou Faction, he was a fisherman from the bay area.

A User that Chris brought along. He was originally a User under Son Faction's facilities, moving from places to places. He does not yet have any actual abilities, nor does he show any interest in combats.
He was once in the same facility as Takaya and Yashiro, so he at least recognizes them when they meet.
A User that Chris brought along. She is physically weak and has trouble moving around. She also has a slim and thin appearance, while people also see her not looking like a girl to add on top.
She has been taking care of a boy and a girl who are around 5 years old ever since they are in a facility. Even after joining Gotou Faction, they do not seem to want to leave her side.
The leader of Gotou Faction.
The leader of Son Faction.
The last Hakkenshi to appear, who was one of the four head executives in Gotou Faction.
Her full name is Ebado Juri. She is Mondo's older sister. Before joining Gotou Faction, she was the leader of the 4th Unit from Son Faction.
She is considered the second strongest Hakkenshi in terms of combat, only after Gotou, although Gotou admits that she could still defeat him in a no rules fight.
A mercenary from the Mainland who has been working under Shiva's orders. She is Sasumi's younger sister.
Member of the Third Unit.
Alongside Rin, she usually comes to the 8th Training School to hang out with Seika and Souga.
Alongside Rika, she usually comes to the 8th Training School to hang out with Seika and Souga.
A mercenary from the Mainland who has been working under Shiva's orders. She is Kagen's older sister.
An executive of Gazer Corporation from the Mainland.
A subordinate of Shiva, he is currently a member of Gazer Corporation who came to Hasou for collaboration work with the Gotou Faction.
Member of the Third Unit.
The new head executive of Gotou Faction after Juri left her position.
A shrine maiden from Tsuji No Kuni, who was sent to Hasou for a certain mission.
